name: Fear-extreme contrarian gated on RSI oversold (capitulation confluence, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: same forced-seller-vs-patient-capital thesis as the bb_z variant, but reads the washout with a DIFFERENT gauge — RSI oversold — to test whether the confluence edge is robust to the technical filter used, not an artifact of one indicator. Extreme fear supplies the emotional forced flow; RSI below a fitted oversold floor confirms the tape is genuinely stretched (not mid-range fear that stays down). Long spot into the discount; exit on RSI recovering through a fitted level or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: if RSI-gated and bb_z-gated versions give identical trades/returns, the gauge is irrelevant and only fear+generic-oversold matters — collapse to one. If net-of-fee return does not beat buy-and-hold on the same oversold days, it is redundant with RSI mean-reversion and news adds nothing — kill.
catalyst: extreme fear into an RSI-oversold tape
